name: result-table-key-floor
description: notification card: the structured result's key column keeps a readable label floor when a value cell carries a huge max-content line - a JSON.stringify'd nested object collapsed 'Artifacts'/'Data'/'Message' to ~2 characters per line in the live hub (2026-11-19, the pr-c2 delegate report)

mutation.declaration: notificationcard.module.css: .resultKey { min-width: 10ch } removed - a JSON.stringify'd data value (~550 characters, one line) collapses the key column to ~30px again
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-19: the live hub rendered the same result table's key column at 30px ([30, 426]); the standalone repro measured 35px before the fix and 94px after it, with 'Artifacts' back on one line.
